Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: ONLY the adult female red-bodied figure, with the BLUE face and RED outfit. SLIM and CURVY adult hourglass proportions: slender arms and calves, long slim legs, small waist, naturally full chest and rounded hips. Slimmer hips/thighs than the previous heavy version, while retaining a clear waist-to-hip curve. Opaque fitted plain red one-piece costume. Face must match the original reference: wider gently oval blue head with a broad forehead and subtly tapered lower cheeks/chin, not a round ball; very large almond-shaped YELLOW eyes, asymmetrical slanted half-lidded blue upper eyelids, long outer lash points, black oval pupils; small CLOSED red curved smile, minimal nose, no round red nose, no big open mouth, no teeth. Mature feminine face, expressive and recognizable as the source. Exclude the blue companion, pointed red cap and open-mouthed red-nosed face. The attached sheet is the REVISED complete-body design. Copy this exact slim hourglass anatomy, head size, eye shape, eyelids and closed mouth in EVERY pose. No round-eyed face, no larger heavy hips/thighs. Same overall standing height, slender limbs, defined waist and rounded hips. This sheet contains ONE actor only; blue companion is completely excluded.
